verdict.rationale: Pipecat has no evidenced built-in AI that generates prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. What it does ship is first-party support for external coding agents: `pipecat context-hub install` registers a local docs/examples/API index as an MCP server for your coding agent, and the quickstart scaffold writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. That lets a third-party AI author Pipecat agents, but only with an extra tool, and Evals tests are user-described rather than AI-generated. Missing for 10: a native platform AI that generates prompts, flows, or test cases from a description, any evidence of AI-generated eval cases, and hands-on corroboration of the AI-assisted authoring workflow.
